snippet.title: Rip Current - Trailer
snippet.description:
Rip Current is a horror game set in a cryptic research facility where genetic experiments, in a bid to strengthen aquatic ecosystems, have spiraled out of control. Navigate flooded corridors, uncover the fate of the scientists, and survive the apex predators stalking the depths.  

Available on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1557220/Rip_Current/
